text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski condemns student and secondary school pupil protests over implementation of use of Albanian language in teachers' academy.
- Second round of local elections in Tetovo passed without incident on Sunday.
- Students read demands for resignation of education minister at rock concert in centre of Skopje on Saturday.
- Survey shows Macedonian intellectuals divided between those that think students are being manipulated by politcal parties and those who believe they are independent.
